items.title: What Could Duke Energy (DUK) Gain From Four New Florida Solar Sites?
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE:DUK) said Duke Energy Florida will build four new solar sites with 300 MW of capacity in its service area. The utility projects the new solar build will contribute to about US$1b in customer savings over the life of the projects. Duke Energy Florida plans to pair the solar rollout with utility scale battery storage aimed at improving system reliability.
